objective: Test one independently implemented, causal trend-following lifecycle across the V63-minus-GOLD roster without deleting assets or reusing rejected V63 route mechanics.

source_prior_art.license_observation: README states Private repository. All rights reserved.
source_prior_art.reuse_policy: No source code copied. Reimplement the mathematical signal and lifecycle contract independently and validate it against local causal tests.
source_prior_art.not_adopted_as_evidence: External backtest or live returns do not establish profitability in this repository, asset roster, cost model, or deployment context.

friction_profiles.funding: include_when_exact_local_funding_is_available; otherwise report omission as a limitation

chronology.opening_rule: Run development first. Open each later partition once, in order, only after freezing the prior-partition disposition; no retuning from validation or pseudo-holdout outcomes.

development_support_criteria: positive nominal net PnL and profit factor above 1 after modeled costs
positive stress net PnL and profit factor above 1
positive net PnL after removing the largest winner
both long and short entry paths are exercised when the market emits both flips
no lookahead, append-invariance, or execution-timing test fails
portfolio_support_criteria: positive net PnL under nominal and stress friction
positive net PnL after removing the largest winner
maximum drawdown is reported and does not exceed the predeclared 25 percent research ceiling
asset concentration, concurrent stop risk, and monthly fold results are reported
research and live entry, stop, target, flip, hold, cost, and sizing semantics match
falsifiers: any decision uses an incomplete 4h bar or future 15m price
an appended future suffix changes any prior signal or stop
nominal or stress development expectancy is non-positive
profitability disappears after removing the largest winner
a route requires asset-specific post-outcome tuning
the shared portfolio breaches the research drawdown ceiling
known_limitations: The HIP3 history is materially shorter than the crypto history.
OHLC backtests cannot reproduce queue position, private IOC rejection, or all mark-price gaps.
A positive historical result would remain a provisional hypothesis, not a profit guarantee.
A negative asset result keeps the asset visible but cannot authorize entries until a separately preregistered replacement passes.
